title: quirivelia zeylanica
intro: Quirivelia zeylanica, commonly known as the Ceylon Quinine or Ceylon Quassia, is a plant species native to Sri Lanka, characterized by its unique properties and medicinal uses. This plant is known to offer various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, malaria, and other infectious diseases due to its antimalarial and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Quirivelia zeylanica include acting as an antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and anxiolytic agent, helping to reduce fever, inflammation, and anxiety levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include compounds like quassin, quassinoids, and limonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
